prompt:
透明背景。Draw ONE whole-body pixel sprite of Ultraman Arc LUNA ARMOR walking SCREEN RIGHT. One complete person, one absolute animation pose, fixed side camera. Image 1 is the exact pose guide: WHITE chain is the NEAR leg; DARK chain is the FAR leg. Image 2 shows this same character with the correct permanent near/far leg colors and far-leg lead. Image 3 is the accepted master identity and armor design.
REQUIRED PHASE 06: FAR SUPPORT / NEAR PASSING. The DARK FAR support leg goes almost straight down beneath the hips and its DARK boot is planted on the ground. The BRIGHT NEAR thigh is lifted, its knee bends forward and its BRIGHT boot is lifted clear of the ground, passing directly beside the dark support calf UNDER THE PELVIS. Both ankles are nearly at the same screen x. The bright foot is UP and the dark foot is DOWN. This is a compact passing pose, feet close together, not a wide fighting stance.
Permanent identity: the leg CLOSER to camera is BRIGHT SILVER and belongs to the near hip. The leg farther from the camera is DARK SILVER and belongs to the far hip. Support is on the DARK FAR LEG throughout this pose. Maintain these colors regardless of left/right foot position. Whole person redrawn together to the absolute pose in image 1; image 2 only clarifies depth and armor continuity, never cut or copy body parts from it.
Small natural torso weight shift above the dark support foot, upright head, coordinated hips/shoulders and both arms guarded. Preserve exact Luna head, low silver crest opening, yellow eye, cyan chest light, blue moon-shaped chest/shoulder armor, round cyan wrist disks and red/silver continuous suit from master image 3. Same limb lengths and anatomy.
Crisp 32-color arcade pixel clusters, hard stepped outlines, upper-left light, natural continuous suit joints with original armor segmentation. No toy joints, screws, plastic seams or supports. True RGBA transparent background; full head, both boots, both hands and all armor tips inside clear margins. No shadows, text, grids, guide lines, skeleton, other people, weapons, glow or FX. No limb swapping, mirroring, rotating or pasted pieces.
